answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by bonding collateral to each identity and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting statements, their correlated penalty scales as O(k^2), rather than independently, while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake. Thus a swarm cannot cheaply forge consensus: even a gale of aliases compounds exposure, and willow accounts with thin collateral become uneconomic.
